title: 第23章 绝代的进化之路一转二尾第24章 不吃草很严重吗

“赤炎金精？那可是高级制作材料，我现在拿来好像没用诶？”
陈小草看着屏幕上一角，露出来的一小块赤红色泛着光芒的金属，有些不解的问道。
“而且它是s级材料，需要至少八百万帝国币，我恐怕没那么多钱买啊。”
【嗯？我没有告诉你吗？】
一行问号缓缓在陈小草头顶飘过。
告诉我。。。了吗？
要告诉我什么？
【嗯，那应该是前段时间太累了，没来得及和你说，现在说也一样的。】
【你契约的御兽是真名御兽，还记得吗？它叫绝代。】
【不同于普通御兽，拥有真名的御兽，是有一条通天之路可以走的。】
【或者换一种说法，说它可以晋升到sss级御兽，你可能更容易理解一点。】
【而绝代的晋升第一步，必须要用到的东西就是赤炎金精，完成一转后，它可以变成二尾赤炎妖狐。】
【一定要想办法拿下它，相信我，这个好处是你想象不到的。】
陈小草沉默了。
如果放在以前，她可能会毫不犹豫的就拒绝这个提议。
八百万帝国币，她会考虑拿来翻新孤儿院，让孩子们吃饱穿暖，再送孩子们去上学，为他们的未来铺路。
剩下的留下来作为自己和奶奶的生活开支。
陈小草没有什么大的理想。
吃得饱，穿得暖，能把八个孩子。。或许后面孤儿院还会有更多的孩子。

把孩子们抚养长大。
自己也成为孤儿院的下一位‘奶奶’。
就是她最大的目标了。
可现在不一样。
坏人撕碎了她卑微的美梦，她能做的，只有撕碎坏人！
“八次兄，我需要赤炎金精。”
陈小草直截了当的将自己的需求说出了口。
“帮你挑选一个价值三百万的a级泰坦血牛，你需要支付我三百万。刚才的赌约，你说的是s级以下的材料任我挑选一份，价值三百万。”
“而这份材料，市场价是八百万，不知道你能不能接受欠债的方式，让我欠下你两百万，或者。。。你有没有什么和御兽有关的任务，价值两百万左右的。”
“只要是和御兽有关，我都能给出解决方案。”
如果说那个叫【别说话，吻我】的网友开b级开出a级蛋，是剧本，是巧合，是骗子给自己下的套。
唐柏还能说服自己，这是骗子的新型套路。

"Red Flame Gold Essence? That's a high-level production material. It seems useless to me now?"
Chen Xiaocao looked at the small piece of red and glowing metal exposed in the corner of the screen, and asked with some confusion.
"And it's an S-class material and requires at least eight million empire coins. I'm afraid I don't have that much money to buy it."
【Huh? Didn't I tell you? 】
A line of question marks slowly floated over Chen Xiaocao's head.
tell me. . . Already?
What do you want to tell me?
[Well, I was probably too tired to talk to you some time ago, and it’s the same thing now. 】
[The beast you contracted is the real name of the beast, do you remember? It's called Juedai. 】
[Unlike ordinary beast masters, those with real names have a path to heaven. 】
[Or to put it another way, it may be easier for you to understand that it can be promoted to SSS level beast master. 】
[As for the first step of peerless promotion, the thing that must be used is the red flame gold spirit. After completing one transformation, it can turn into a two-tailed red flame demon fox. 】
[You must find a way to win it. Believe me, this benefit is beyond your imagination. 】
Chen Xiaocao fell silent.
In the past, she might have rejected the proposal without hesitation.
She would consider using the eight million imperial coins to renovate the orphanage, feed and clothe the children, and then send the children to school to pave the way for their future.
The rest is left as living expenses for myself and my grandma.
Chen Xiaocao doesn't have any big ideals.
Well fed, warmly clothed, and able to raise eight children. . Maybe there will be more children in the orphanage later.
Raise the children up.
She also became the next 'grandma' of the orphanage.
That's her biggest goal.
But it's different now.
The bad guy tore her humble dream into pieces. All she can do is tear the bad guy to pieces!
"Brother Baci, I need the red flame gold spirit."
Chen Xiaocao stated his needs straightforwardly.
"I will help you choose an A-grade Titan Blood Ox worth three million, and you need to pay me three million. In the bet just now, you said that I would choose a piece of materials below S-grade, worth three million."
"And the market price of this material is eight million. I wonder if you can accept the debt method and let me owe you two million, or... do you have any tasks related to beast control that are worth about two million."
"As long as it's related to beast control, I can give you a solution."
If the netizen named [Stop talking, kiss me] opened a B-level egg and opened an A-level egg, it was a script, a coincidence, and a trap set by a liar.
Tang Bai could still convince himself that this was a new trick of swindlers.
